notes.title: Happy New Year & Xmas!
notes.content:
Greetings again, dear subscribers. We met this new year and spent the old one. We look to the future and we are glad that you are still with us. In the next update, I hope, we will add even more music, several functions, and really want to add free dlc in which there will be all the songs that you could hear in this game.
Let this be our belated New Year's gift for you. Well, your presents for us are your feedback/reviews about the product. Whether they are positive or negative, they helping us make the game more interesting. Thanks. Sammy W.
